sources.snippet: Experimental demonstration for the Qwen/Qwen-Image-Edit-2511 model with lazy-loaded LoRA adapters supporting multi-image input editing. Users can upload one or more images (gallery format) and apply advanced edits such as pose transfer, anime conversion, or camera angle changes via natural language prompts. Features integrated Rerun SDK.
